title: Perfect Match 3D
description:
Dive into a colorful world filled with charming objects and satisfying puzzles. Search through hundreds of items, find identical objects, and collect them in groups of three to clear the board.

As you progress, levels become more challenging and packed with even more objects to discover. Improve your focus, observation skills, and quick thinking while enjoying a relaxing gameplay experience.

title: Steal A Fish
description: Dive straight into a thrilling underwater world in Steal A Fish, where stealth meets chaos in a fast-paced adventure and action experience! This unique simulator challenges you to sneak through the deep sea, steal valuable fish, and escape before danger strikes. The deeper you go, the greater the risk and the reward!

title: Football Penalty 2026
description: The time has come for the players to face off in an intense duel to prove who has the strongest, most accurate and most technically skilled kick. Show your opponents the power of your accurate shots and become a real football hero. The road to victory is yours!

title: Hexa Arrows Puzzle
description: Hexa Arrows Puzzle is an engaging, relaxing brain teaser for everyone who loves logic challenges and minimalism. If you enjoy hexagon sorting and dismantling colorful towers, then this game is definitely for you!

title: Football Heads 2026
description: Step onto the field and dominate crazy 1v1 football matches! Outplay your opponents using powerful kicks and unique power-ups. Finally let them know who is the boss with the emotes system - become a football legend today!

title: Cute Animal World
description: Manage your own animal paradise in Cute Animal World. Play as Senti, build a grand stage for cowboy dreams, and run the entire animal city. Hand out flyers to attract visitors and hire music-loving performers to make your park lively! Enjoy the perfect mix of casual idle fun, management simulation and adorable animal elements, all while designing your dream park!

title: Fashion Makeover Dash
description: Ready for a fun fashion adventure? In Fashion Makeover Dash, you can run through the mall, collect cute outfits, stylish accessories, and shiny coins along the way! After the dash, it’s makeover time! Dress up your character with all the fashion items you collected and create the cutest look ever. You can also use coins to decorate your room and make it extra stylish. Run, collect, dress up, and have fun in the ultimate fashion makeover game!

title: Break a Lucky Block!
description:
What's inside the Lucky Blocks? ?

Break lucky blocks before you get caught! ⛏️

Grab the brainrots that spawn! ✨
Bring them back to your plot!

title: Backyard Dig Hole 3D Simulator
description:
Become a Gemstone Hunter in Your Own Backyard!

Ever dreamed of being a real miner and digging for treasure in your own backyard? Backyard Dig Hole 3D Simulator brings that fantasy to life with realistic graphics that make you feel like you're truly digging deep to find valuable gemstones and metals hidden beneath the earth!

title: Cat Pancake Diner
description: Run your own pancake diner full of adorable cats! Serve hungry customers, manage your feline staff and expand your diner across multiple cozy locations. Flip pancakes and build your breakfast empire in this charming 3D simulation game.

title: Racing in City
description: Racing in City is a driving game where you dodge traffic and complete challenges. Navigate through city traffic on a range of tracks while sitting with a view from behind the wheel. Participate in a long and illustrious driving career. Earn points and cash them in for cars and upgrades.

title: Cut the Grass 3D
description:
Get ready for the most satisfying and addictive lawn-mowing adventure!

In Cut the Grass 3D, your mission is simple but incredibly fun: clear the overgrown lawns, unlock powerful cutting blades, and transform messy gardens into perfectly manicured masterpieces.

title: Mazoo
description: Mazoo is a colorful maze adventure for kids and families. Guide your character through hand-drawn labyrinths across Forest, Dungeon, Space, and Ocean worlds. Collect stars and find the exit!

title: Collect Brainrot Arena
description: Collect Brainrot Arena is a chaotic multiplayer collecting and stealing game where luck, strategy, and timing are equally important. Enter the arena, gather valuable Lucky Blocks, unlock rare Brainrots, upgrade your collection, and protect your base from rival thieves. Every Lucky Block can contain a surprise, and every opponent is looking for an opportunity to steal your most valuable Brainrots.

title: Magic Water Sort: Color Puzzle
description: Welcome to Magic Water Sort: Color Puzzle, a relaxing and addictive puzzle game full of colorful bottles and magical fun. Pour and sort the water until each bottle holds only one color. Enjoy satisfying gameplay, smooth controls, and hundreds of brain-teasing levels. Challenge your logic, train your mind, and unwind anytime with this fun and calming water sort adventure.

title: Dress Up Outfit Match
description: Fashion chaos meets brain-teasing fun in Dress Up: Outfit Match! Get ready to organize stylish clothes, complete exciting makeover challenges, and become the ultimate fashion expert. This addictive adventure combines creative styling with clever puzzle mechanics, making every level feel fresh and satisfying. It blends strategy with a stylish dress up outfit match game experience. Enjoy a charming girl fashion styling game full of personality and creativity.

title: Kompot's Kitchen
description: Flip the cards, cook up tasty combos and pay the kitchen rent! A cozy roguelike with chef cat Kompot and hundreds of culinary synergies. Free to play!

title: Mine&Build
description: Mine&Build is a fun resource mining game. Build a flying plate and escape the planet. Gather valuable materials, explore diverse locations, overcome obstacles, craft useful structures, and use your strategy to complete the journey and reach freedom.

title: Scoop Tower
description: Scoop Tower is an addictive hyper-casual 3D ice cream stacking game where you build the tallest dessert tower possible. Drop scoops with perfect timing, balance your tower, and stop it from falling. Earn “Perfect” drops to trigger Fever Mode and beat high scores. Face tricky wind gusts, challenge friends, or enjoy relaxing endless stacking fun anytime.

title: Brick Blaze
description: Smash your way through colorful blocks in BrickBlaze! Bounce the ball off your paddle to destroy all the bricks on the screen. Catch power-ups to enhance your paddle and clear levels faster in this classic arcade reimagining.

title: Skibidi Titans Hide And Seek
description: Skibidi Titans Hide And Seek throws you into a thrilling battle between clever escape artists and relentless hunters. Choose your side, master unique character abilities, and outsmart your opponents in this exciting Fun Hide Seek Game with Skibidi Titans. Quick thinking and careful movement are the keys to victory in this exciting stealth adventure. Great for fans of role-playing adventures. One of the most entertaining free online games for competitive players.

title: Obby: Pump Up Your Muscles! 1 per second
description:
Welcome to the prison gym, where only strength earns respect!
You start as a skinny rookie, but every rep makes you stronger. Push-ups, sit-ups, pull-ups — build your body and rise through the ranks.

title: Arrow Shift Logic Tree
description: In Arrow Shift Logic Tree, every movement must follow the rules of the arrows. One wrong slide can leave you trapped, while one clever move can unlock the perfect path. If you enjoy a smart puzzle game that rewards observation and planning, this journey is waiting for you.

title: Moto Race City
description: Time is key. The longer you ride, the more money you earn to unlock faster, stronger bikes. Feel the speed, upgrade your ride and become unstoppable. Every map is a new challenge — faster, harder and more dangerous.

title: Food Sort Puzzle
description: Food Sort Puzzle combines colorful dishes with clever gameplay, delivering a fun and engaging puzzle experience you’ll keep coming back to. Your task is to match food plates with tables based on color. Sounds easy at first - but with only four empty slots available, every move requires smart planning. This mix of sort mechanics and logic thinking creates a highly satisfying casual game.

title: Tiny Golf King
description: Simple, intuitive, fun and addicting. Make it to the top in Tiny Golf King! Complete more than 45 challenging levels and be the King of Tiny golf

title: Grandfather Road Chase Realistic Shooter Guns
description:
Your goal is to stop the chase. But bad luck, you have a rather weak car.
But you have plenty of weapons!

Use a huge arsenal of weapons
AK47, Minigun, Crossbow, Stationary gun, Machine gun, Flamethrower.

Shoot car parts, wheels. Hand out headshots, do combos! Shoot weapons, machine guns, stationary guns

Attacking arsenal is huge
Realistic Motorcycles, ATVs, racing cars, drones, jeeps, helicopters

Unlock all locations
Defeat all bosses

title: SnakeLands.io
description: The wild is alive with motion and danger. Rival snakes close in, waiting for a single mistake. Grow faster, bite harder and outsmart them all. Evolve beyond limits and show that only those with courage and cunning can claim true power.

title: Sweeper Curling
description:
Sweeper Curling is a fun and easy ice curling game for the whole family!
Slide your stones down the ice, aim for the target, and sweep to control
the speed. Play against a smart AI or challenge a friend in 2-player mode.
Simple controls and colorful graphics make it easy for everyone to enjoy!

title: Survive Lava for Brainrots!
description:
Run faster and collect Brainrots! ?
Avoid the rising lava! ?
Upgrade your Brainrots! ?
Upgrade your base to place more Brainrots! ?️

title: Mountain Bus Driver
description: Drive through breathtaking hill stations and challenging mountain roads. Pick up passengers and drop them safely across snowy routes, forest hills, and narrow passes. Master steep climbs and sharp turns in this immersive mountain bus driving adventure.

title: Ball Sort
description: Ball Sort is a relaxing yet addictive color sorting puzzle. Move colorful balls between tubes and organize them by color until every tube contains only matching balls. Plan your moves carefully, use empty spaces wisely, and solve increasingly challenging levels. Easy to learn but difficult to master, Ball Sort offers satisfying gameplay that will keep your brain engaged for hours.

title: WordMix
description:
WordMix is a game where words hide their connections, and you uncover them.
The board is filled with word cards. Some of them share a theme, meaning, or association. Your task is to sense the link and bring the words of one group into a single row.
Sometimes the answer is obvious. Sometimes you have to think. And finding the right link feels great.
Play hundreds of levels and endless mode!

title: Lazy Dog
description: Jump into this cozy puzzle game and help your adorable pup reunite with his beloved ball! Calculate the angles, time your moves, and draw lines to help the lazy dog catch his beloved ball by guiding it to him with ropes. With satisfying physics, cozy visuals, and challenging puzzles, Lazy Dog is the perfect game for the whole family. No ads, no in app purchases - just pup-tastic fun!

title: Music Tiles: Fluffy Hop Beat
description:
Jump on music tiles to the beat! Control a fluffy character, complete levels, collect points, and don’t miss a tile!
Easy to learn , but it requires focus and a good sense of rhythm, especially at higher speeds

title: Mononinja
description:
Make precise jumps while avoiding certain death. Guide a brave ninja to his goal as he overcomes his deadly obstacles. Over 30 levels filled with fun and challenge. Are you up for the challenge?

Only one way to find out if you truly have what it takes to be a shinobi.

title: Color Clash
description: Choose your color wisely, expand your territory with precision, and outmaneuver your opponent in a world where every shade counts.

title: Cars vs Zombies
description: "Cars vs Zombies" is an arcade vehicular survival action game. Drive your car, annihilate waves of zombies, and destroy the interactive environment in the arenas. Earn resources to upgrade your vehicles in the garage: improve stats, install attachable armor, and equip boosters. Multiple maps and vehicle types are available.

title: 2 Player Games Design Salon
description: The Creative Showdown is officially underway! In the 2 Player Games Design Salon, you’ll compete in a real-time design contest against another player, with aesthetics and creativity determining the winner. Every round introduces a new artistic task packed with fun surprises. Built around expressive design gameplay, the experience stays relaxing yet competitive, making it a perfect casual multiplayer challenge.

title: Idle Vlogger Simulator
description: Try yourself as a Youtuber! Create a channel and make videos on different topics! Improve your equipment and skills to get to the top of the best Youtubers!

title: Mirror Shape
description: A geometry-based puzzle game.  Shapes are reflected across any edge to create symmetrical shapes. The goal is to match the target shape on the left.

title: Boat Game: Racing Simulator 3D
description: Get ready to jump on the quickest, most daring boat jet ski to experience the ultimate thrill ride complete with massive air jumps! Navigate across the waterways while dodging the players of your opponents. You can also expect some water ramps for some incredible air stunts! The drag boat race is about to start. Can you construct a rooster tail as high as possible? Discover the ideal mix of speed boat parts to produce large rooster tails. One of the hardest boat games available is this one.

title: Family Pet Dog Games
description:
Step into the exciting world of virtual pet adventures with the Family Pet Dog Simulator!

Experience the joy of living with a cute and loyal puppy as you help your virtual family in daily home and neighborhood activities. Play as a lovable family dog and assist virtual mom with cleaning the messy house, completing household chores, and helping neighbours in this fun filled dog simulator game.

title: Virtual Neko Kitty Collector
description: Welcome to Virtual Neko: Kitty Collector, a casual cat game that you can play for free. Dive into a super cute world with cute kittens. Buy items, feed them, and earn red hearts to upgrade your cats' yard.

title: Photo Block Journey
description: Move picture blocks across the board and place them in the right order to complete the image. Look carefully at the layout, plan your moves, and find the best way to solve each puzzle. The gameplay is simple from the first level: slide the tiles, open the path, and complete the picture.

title: DRAG & Match Maze - TILE
description: DRAG & Match Maze Tile is a fresh puzzle experience where strategy meets smooth drag mechanics. Move tiles through twisting mazes and match identical pieces to clear the board. Every move counts  one wrong drag can block your path!

title: Stickman Dismount Simulator
description:
Stickman physics simulation. Use the turbo to smash him into barriers and traps.

Stickman Dismount: The hottest stunt action game of 2022. You will perform stunts through all the oncoming obstacles to break as many stickman bones as you can.

title: Find Hidden Secrets
description: A world brimming with mysteries to find, waiting for sharp eyes and steady hands. Manage your clicks carefully — too many mistakes slow you down! But with two unique power-ups at your side, you'll conquer challenging levels one by one.

title: Obby Escape from Tsunami Brainrot
description:
Immerse yourself in a dynamic Roblox-inspired action game inspired by the Obby genre, where every second counts. Outrun the oncoming tsunami, upgrade your speed and strength, collect resources, and survive the frantic pace.
Develop your base and Brainrot collection, earn currency even offline, and unlock new progression opportunities.

title: Sneaky Friends
description: Sneaky Friends takes your favorite childhood game to a whole new level—set in a school with a scary twist! Find the perfect hiding spot, use your quick reflexes to escape, and outsmart her at every turn. Rescue your teammates and collect coins to unlock. Ready for some high-stakes hide and seek?

title: Downtown Parkour Drive
description:
Downtown Parkour Drive is a fast-paced stunt driving game set in a wide open city training ground. Take control of a powerful sports car and push your driving skills to the limit as you complete a series of challenging parkour-style levels.

Each level is designed with ramps, platforms, and precision-based obstacles that require perfect timing and control. From simple jumps to complex stunt sequences, the difficulty increases as you progress through all 30 levels.

title: Fishing: Catch the Secret Brainrot
description:
Explore a large sea world where fishing is the core of the adventure ??
Sail across the sea, travel between islands, and fish in many different locations. This online fishing game lets you catch fish, brainrots, and mysterious creatures while exploring a living ocean world filled with secrets ?️
Use your boat to move between islands and search for the best fishing spots ?

title: TIny Football Cup 2026
description: Every match is a new challenge and every tournament a chance to make history! Become a football legend by winning them all. Unlock all the leagues and play with 28 different teams. Prove to your friends you are the number one football player.

title: Screwdom 3D
description: Welcome to the challenging world of teardowns. In Screwdom 3D, your goal is to carefully remove all coins from the slots while collecting gold to decorate your house. Simple to control but full of strategy, every click brings satisfaction. The game tests both observation and timing. It blends screw mechanics with puzzle solving. Enjoy easy-going and engaging match and logic challenges that keep you thinking while having fun. A true casual puzzle game that’s hard to put down!

title: Single Line: Drawing Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind and unleash your creativity with Single Line: Drawing Puzzle! This exciting game is perfect for anyone who loves brain teasers and enjoys solving clever puzzles. Your mission is simple yet addictive: draw one continuous line to complete intricate designs without lifting your finger or retracing your steps. Are you ready to take on this one-line challenge? ?

title: Crunch Locked
description: Crunch Locked is a satisfying puzzle game where every move brings the pieces closer together. Tap available segments to snap them into place and gradually build complete shapes. As the structure collapses into a single remaining piece, the final segment crunches away and clears the level. With locked parts, blocked paths, and increasingly clever layouts, every puzzle requires careful planning and the right sequence of moves.

title: Meme Myth:Wukong
description: Meme Myth: Wokong is a hilarious brainrot puzzle game inspired by classic myth, absurd memes, and totally unexpected logic. Help the monkey hero survive ridiculous situations, solve weird puzzles, and discover the dumbest-but-smartest answers in each level. Nothing works the normal way here — think sideways, tap everything, and enjoy the chaos.

title: Sudoku Classic – Daily Brain Puzzle
description: Enjoy the ultimate Sudoku experience for players of all skill levels! Challenge your brain with classic Sudoku puzzles from easy to expert difficulty. Improve your logic, focus, and problem-solving skills while relaxing with a clean and intuitive interface. Features include multiple difficulty levels, a helpful hint system, auto-save, and smooth gameplay on both desktop and mobile. Play anytime, train your mind, and become a true Sudoku master!

title: Burger Here
description: From a small restaurant to a burger empire! Serve customers, clean tables, hire the best staff and deliver orders on time. Make each burger a masterpiece that everyone will crave. Expand to 4 restaurants and attract more customers.

title: Slap Man
description:
Slap Man is a hyper-casual parkour game that involves sliding left and right. You sprint through the streets, dodging roadblocks and traps, while sending passing NPCs staggering with well-timed slaps. Its easy to play, brainless and refreshing. If you want to get high scores, you have to be accurate, fast and bad enough.
Suitable for playing in fragmented time, supports mouse/touch operation, and is an easy-to-learn little spoof of parkour!

title: Racing for two on one PC!
description: Arcade racing for two on one PC - get the most out of the car, beat your friend and be the first. Set a world record and let the whole world know your name!

title: Family Simulator Beach Games
description: Get ready to enjoy exciting winter holidays with your virtual family in this fun filled family vacation simulator. Travel with mom, dad, and family members to beautiful vacation destinations and experience memorable picnic adventures. Complete thrilling activities, explore amazing locations, and enjoy realistic family life in this vacation simulator game.

title: Busy Bee Hive
description:
Busy Bee Hive is an engaging idle management game where you build and grow your own honey business empire! 

Start small by collecting nectar from flowers and processing it into delicious honey products. Expand your operations by unlocking new production stations, from basic honey extractors to luxury candle makers and royal jelly labs.

title: Bubble Shooter Vale
description: Bubble Shooter Vale is a fun and relaxing bubble shooting puzzle game where you match colorful bubbles and clear the board before time runs out. Use strategy, quick thinking, and precise shots to create huge combos. If the board gets filled, watch a reward ad to remove the last 3 lines of bubbles, or stop the timer and continue playing in relaxing mode.

title: Number Merge Master
description: Begin a fast-thinking number showdown in Number Merge Master! One wrong step could cost you health, but a smart merge can keep you in the game and push your score even higher. Perfect for fans of puzzle-style gameplay who love quick decision-making and endless replay value.

title: Cat vs Granny. Cat Simulator
description: Immerse yourself in madness and fun as a mischievous cat who decided to turn grandma's cozy house into a field of chaos! ? Break pots, steal fish from the aquarium, throw things and scratch everything that comes under your paw. And all this is in the form of a first-person simulator with elements of humor and mayhem.

title: Topsy Turvy
description:
A spooky-cute arcade puzzler where you control a quirky little steampunk cannon.
Shoot and match creepy eyeballs or skull orbs before they slither their way to the drain!
Chain combos, clear the track, and survive as the creepy snake keeps crawling closer.
Simple to play, tricky to master and just the right amount of creepy.

title: Scrap Car Merge
description: Scrap Car Merge is a fast arcade game about driving, shooting, and upgrading your own battle car. Drive forward through a dangerous road, shoot enemies, survive attacks, and reach the end of each level. After every run, upgrade your car with new parts, stronger weapons, and better firepower to prepare for the next battle.

title: Arrowtix - Train Your Brain
description: Arrowtix is a satisfying, brain-teasing puzzle game where your goal is to clear the board by sliding tangled arrows out of the grid. But there's a catch: each arrow can only move in the direction it's pointing, and its escape path must be completely empty! With 60 tricky levels spread across Normal, Medium, and Hard difficulties, Arrowtix will test your spatial logic and strategic thinking. Can you untangle the mess and clear the board?

title: Math Stars
description:
"Math Stars: Space Expedition is an exciting educational math game designed for children ages 6-7. Travel through the galaxy, visit beautiful planets, and defeat space bosses by solving addition and subtraction problems!

Features:
• 4 unique planets with different bosses
• Progressive difficulty from easy addition to harder subtraction
• Colorful graphics and fun animations
• Star rating system to track progress
• Cloud save support
• Available in 18 languages

title: Blocks and that's it
description: Welcome to “Blocks and That’s It” — an addictive Tetris-style puzzle! Drag and drop blocks onto an 8×8 grid, clear lines, and trigger satisfying combo blasts to score points. Simple rules but deep strategy: plan ahead and create chains. No timers, lives, or limits — just relaxing, endless gameplay for all ages. Compete for high scores, enjoy colorful visuals, and master the puzzle. Play now and prove you’re the champion!

title: Worm Puzzle Snake Apple
description: Worm Puzzle: Snake Apple combines classic snake gameplay with creative puzzle challenges. You solve spatial problems, escape traps, and guide snakes through clever levels. With funny snake movements and playful interactions, it brings a strong Funny vibe while still offering smart puzzle challenges. Fans of casual games enjoy its relaxing pace, while puzzle lovers enjoy the deep puzzle design. It also offers a calming relaxation flow with surprising twists in every level.

title: SUGAR POP LAND
description: Match 3 or more sweets of the same type horizontally or vertically to clear them! Match 4 or more to create special sweets. Combine special sweets for even better effects! Clear all target sweets to complete the stage.

title: High School Teacher Games Life
description:
Welcome to the High School Teacher Games Life, where you can experience the real life of a high school teacher. 
Career Mode: Experience the full journey of a high school teacher and manage your daily school life.
Mission Mode: Complete exciting and challenging tasks to test your teaching skills. 
Quiz Mode: Take quizzes and conduct practical sessions with students as a teacher.

title: Blocky Archer Run
description:
Draw, Aim, and Loose!

Dash through challenging environments in this fast-paced, action-packed stickman adventure! Stick Archer Run combines endless running with precision archery. Test your reflexes as you sprint forward—all you have to do is aim your bow, time your shots, and take down enemies before they stop you. Simple to play, hard to master. How far can you run?

title: Fallling Jewels
description:
Unearth the Ultimate Fortune! ?
Step into a world of sparkling gems and addictive puzzles! In this fast-paced match-3 challenge, your goal is to harvest as many dazzling Jewels as you can.

Master the Mechanics: Slide left or right to align your gems, flick up to rotate for the perfect fit, and slam down to drop!

 Blast the Board: Earn explosive rewards and deploy them strategically to shatter obstacles and clear the way to a high score.

Are you ready to shine? Start matching today!

title: SKYHILL: Escape From the Skyscraper!
description:
Young businessman Perry arrives in town to close a lucrative deal. Perry rents a penthouse in the city's most luxurious hotel. Especially since this damn war with the Confederacy is finally ending! But upon arrival, something terrible happens.

A desperate biological attack by the losing Confederates caught everyone by surprise. Something happened that no one could have imagined. They launched hundreds of missiles and plunged the entire world, including themselves, into chaos.

title: Football Superstars 2026
description: Ready for your next football challenge? Test your skills in a friendly match, or jump right in and lead your dream team in the World Tournament against international teams. Remember, no one ever drowned in sweat!

title: Bubble Blasters
description: Bubble Blasters is a colorful side-scrolling adventure where you blast bubbles to clear levels, trap enemies, and earn stars. Pick your hero, upgrade your gear, and push through challenging stages filled with traps, keys, and hidden rewards. Easy to pick up, satisfying to master—every shot counts.

title: Tank Strike Wasteland Rogue
description: Enter a brutal wasteland battlefield in Tank Strike: Wasteland Rogue. You're straight into explosive war zones filled with enemies and chaos. Control a powerful tank and drive into hostile territory. Destroy enemy strongholds, collect rewards, and unleash nonstop action. Every encounter is a test of survival and skill-packed combat, where only the strongest survive and eliminate all enemies. Play Tank Strike: Wasteland Rogue online for free.

title: Hole Puzzle
description: Hole Puzzle is a fun and addictive casual game where a hungry cat with a magical black-hole mouth is ready to eat everything in sight! Move across colorful levels, collect tasty food, complete objectives, and grow bigger with every bite. Easy to play, satisfying to master, and packed with charming visuals, exciting challenges, and endless food-collecting fun. Can you become the biggest hungry kitty of all?

title: Magic Brick Wars
description:
Magic Brick Wars is the premium version of the quirky tower defence game you love! Exclusive to this version of Magic Brick Wars - enjoy uninterrupted strategic action.

Welcome to the magic world of Magic Brick Wars. Fight wars with your favorite characters from games like Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride using your own Raskulls!

title: Doctor Chicken
description: It looks like all the kids in town have turned into little monsters! Hurry and heal them all! You need to feed them sweets so they can turn back into kids.

title: Toss The Ring
description: Ready to test your aim in Toss The Ring! This addictive ring-toss challenge turns simple throwing mechanics into an exciting skill arcade adventure. Every level introduces new surprises, making the gameplay both relaxing and thrilling. Fans of casual and relaxation games will love every second of this colorful experience! Thanks to the Simple one-tap mechanics, anyone can start playing instantly.

title: Pop The Bubble
description: Think you have what it takes to master the bubble chaos? Precision is everything! Navigate tricky patterns, use boosters wisely and spin the Lucky Wheel for extra rewards. With infinite levels, the game stays fresh and addictive through every challenge.

title: Kick Lucky Boxes Online
description: Kick Lucky Boxes Online is a fast-paced progression game where players launch lucky blocks across dangerous arenas to discover rare Brainrots and valuable rewards. Upgrade kick power, improve speed, and return safely before tsunamis flood the map. The game features online solo play with chat and room invites, local 2-player gameplay, character customization, rebirth progression, and more than 75 collectible Brainrots across 14 rarity classes.

title: Mr Stickman Gunner
description: Mr Stickman Gunner  is an exciting 2D shooter game about stick little men. The game has an unusual aiming system. After each shot it will be difficult to aim again, because the kickback of the weapon will act on your stick little men. And the more powerful the shot, the stronger the weapon or even your hero will be thrown. Destroy all enemies and complete more than 40 levels.

title: Asylum: Baldi Granny Slender
description: You'll be heading into the forest to find a mental hospital. Legend has it that this mental hospital is where rare Brainrot figurines are found. Characters like Baldi, Granny, and Slenderman guard these figurines. A bipedal deer also lives in the forest, so be careful not to fall into their clutches! You can hide under beds in the mental hospital to avoid being caught by the monsters.

title: City Gas Station Simulator
description: Ever dreamed of running a bustling gas station? City Gas Station Simulator lets you experience the thrill of managing every detail of your very own station in a fun 3D casual simulator! From fueling cars to running a mini shop, every choice is yours to make. Fun and addictive casual management gameplay. Mix shopping and service for maximum efficiency.

title: Stickman Adventure
description: This is an adventure that will take you through time and space! Along the way, you'll encounter various traps and monsters; you'll need to defeat them and rescue your friends. Come on, Hero, a whole new world awaits!

title: Pato Vs Cops
description: lay Pato Vs Cops — the ultimate free browser police chase game! No download needed — jump into nonstop car chases, dodge roadblocks, and outdrive relentless cops in fast-paced arcade action. Perfect for fans of unblocked racing games, endless car chase games, and online driving challenges. Show off your reflexes, collect power-ups, and see how long you can survive the heat in this thrilling high-speed pursuit!

title: Live 100 Days
description: Survive 100 days in a chaotic life simulation where every choice matters. Manage danger, resources, and unexpected events as you try to stay alive for as long as possible.

title: Pogo Masters
description: Bounce into action in Pogo Masters! Race against rivals in chaotic, physics-based platform battles where balance is everything. Compete online against players worldwide or challenge a friend locally on the same PC. Unlock dozens of unique characters, stylish pogo sticks, and eye-catching trail effects as you climb the global leaderboard. Fast-paced, competitive, and endlessly fun — become the ultimate pogo champion!

title: Stick: Tactics & Destruction
description: Stick: Tactics & Destruction! For fans of Stick War, Teardown, and Playground. Limited ammo, grenades, monsters, explosions. Destroy everything and win!

title: Zombie Rush
description:
Zombies Rush is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter that pits a lone survivor against an endless, evolving horde. Built for fluid action, this 2D arcade shooter, turns every escape into a high-stakes dance with death.
Tilt and weave through trees to outmaneuver the rush.
Each wave brings faster, smarter, and deadlier undead threats.
Experience a modern take on the classic zombie survival genre with clean, stylized graphics and kinetic combat.

title: Coin Blitz
description: Fast-paced coin shooting action! Destroy waves of enemies, collect tons of coins, and grow stronger as you play. Drag and position your shooter strategically while watching satisfying coin explosions and smooth gameplay. Simple to start, hard to master — how long can you survive?

title: Apocalypse Shelter
description: The world has fallen — but survival is still possible. Build and expand your shelter, manage resources, and create a safe haven in a hostile environment. Assemble a squad of unique heroes, each with their own abilities and combat style. Engage in tactical turn-based battles, plan your moves, and use your team’s skills to overcome dangerous enemies. Unlock new characters from chests, upgrade their cards, and build the ultimate squad to survive the apocalypse.

title: Snake Puzzle Escape
description: Get ready for a fast-paced puzzle experience where your goal is to wiggle the snake through each grid while avoiding obstacles and other snakes. With simple controls and a variety of challenging levels, this is the perfect game for quick play during your free time.

title: Car Parking Simulator
description: Car Parking Simulator is a driving challenge game you won't be able to put down! Whether you want to tackle challenging levels or practice precision parking, you can choose from different modes to start your adventure. From compact car models to heavy-duty truck options, every level offers a fresh driving challenge. As you progress, the levels become more demanding, turning every success into a rewarding challenge.

title: Obby Champions
description: A journey awaits you where every wall is a challenge, every obstacle is an ancient seal, and every punch is a step towards legend. Explore unique zones, fight titans, and find rare pets with unique abilities. Enter hidden codes, collect fragments of history, and leave your mark in the Hall of Echoes - only the strongest will be able to break all the seals and become the Fist of Legends!

title: Ninja Survivor
description: Become a nimble ninja and embark on a dangerous adventure through many levels filled with traps, enemies, and puzzles. Explore colorful 3D locations, avoid deadly mechanisms, and fight zombies and powerful bosses using speed, reflexes, and strategy. Each level requires focus and skill. Upgrade your character, unlock new weapons, and collect stylish skins to grow stronger and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

title: Bubble Shooter Vintage
description:
Play the vintage classic - Bubble Shooter!

One of the most compelling bubble shooter games is available for FREE!
Aim your cannon, SHOOT and match three same color bubbles to pop your way to the highest score.

title: GenFire
description:
GenFire is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where players fight endless waves of enemies in intense 360° combat.

Survive increasingly difficult levels, defeat elemental creatures, and collect coins while mastering your strategy.

Features:
- 20 handcrafted levels across multiple chapters
- Unique enemy mechanics including splitting fire slimes and bosses
- Skill-based gameplay with increasing difficulty

title: Sniper Master
description: Take aim in mid-air and strike at the perfect moment! In Sniper Master, you jump, float, and fire while airborne—time your shots to eliminate targets with clean, satisfying hits. Stay calm, lead your aim, and master precision shooting across multiple levels. Earn rewards, improve your skills, and become the ultimate airborne marksman.

title: ColorWars.io - Conquest Game
description: Color Wars is a fast-paced strategy game where you battle three opponents to control the most territory before time runs out. Deploy powerful cards like Warrior, Ranger, Thunder, and Wizard, each with unique abilities. Earn trophies by ranking in the top two and use gold to upgrade your cards. Plan smart moves, outplay rivals, and dominate the battlefield.

title: PaperWar.io
description: There are so many unexplored areas! Conquering them is the key to mastering the game. Expand your territory, eliminate other players who threaten your progress and aim to conquer 100% of each new map. Choose from 9 special skins to express your style!

title: Pubg Hack
description: Experience the ultimate shooting adventure. In Pubg Hack, you step into the battlefield as an elite soldier, exploring massive maps and engaging in fierce combat. Select a location to land and begin searching for supplies.

title: World Cup Soccer Caps
description: World Cup Soccer Caps is a fun and fast-paced tabletop-style soccer game where you control a team of caps, flicking them to pass, shoot, and score goals. Strategize your moves, outplay your opponent, and aim for victory in this exciting, skill-based challenge!

title: Darling Doll
description: Darling Doll is the ultimate paper doll DIY game that offers a perfect blend of character creation and dress-up game. With a vast collection of outfits, accessories, and hairstyles, you can unleash your creativity and design unique avatars that reflect your personal style. Whether you prefer chibi dolls or glamorous fashion dolls, Darling Doll has got you covered.

title: Bloons Survival.io
description:
Bloons Survival. io is a fast-paced survival arcade game where you fight off endless waves of balloons!

Control your monkey hero, throw darts automatically, and pop incoming enemies before they get too close.
Collect coins and power-ups to grow stronger, but stay alert — one hit can end your run!

How long can you survive?

title: Football Legends 2026
description: Football Legends 2026 is a fast-paced arcade soccer game where you can play solo or challenge your friends in exciting 1v1 and 2v2 matches. Choose from a variety of unique players, each with special abilities like powerful superkicks or teleportation, and use them to outplay your opponents. Compete in tournaments, master your timing and strategy, and score incredible goals to become the ultimate soccer champion

title: Tank Challenge
description:
Tank Challenge is an action-packed tank battle game that tests your reflexes and strategy. Play solo or challenge a friend in fast-paced matches.

Defeat your opponent using powerful weapons like lasers, triple bullets, bomb shells, and rockets.

Make quick decisions, aim carefully, and stay ahead to win. Smooth on mobile and desktop, easy to learn but challenging to master.

Enter the arena and fight for victory!

title: Archers Ragdoll Physics
description: Archers Ragdoll Physics is a physics-based archery action game where ragdoll characters fight using special arrows. The game features 10 characters and 12 unique arrows such as lightning, fire, poison, missile, and rocket. Players can equip three arrows and switch between them during battles. Some levels include traps like electric cables and spinning gears that can be activated with arrows. In 2 Player Mode, players choose from 7 arrows and compete to hit their opponent the most.

title: Traffic Racing
description: Traffic Racing is a fast-paced driving game that throws you into intense highway action where every second counts. Weave through heavy traffic at high speeds as you compete in Career Mode or test your skills against others in Racing League Online.

title: Island Expander
description:
Island Expander — relaxing crafting game. Collect resources, discover 30+ recipes, and grow your island step by step!
It is a cozy crafting game where you transform a tiny island into a paradise.
Collect resources, unlock recipes, craft items — from simple tools to complex machines — and watch your island grow with every step.

Start building your dream island today! ?

title: Terra Craft World
description: Terra Craft World invites you to explore an open world where every decision shapes your journey. Begin an unforgettable adventure filled with discovery and creativity. This game perfectly blends exploration, building, and survival mechanics into one exciting experience. Whether you enjoy creating structures or overcoming environmental dangers, every moment feels rewarding and dynamic. Discover more craft and building experiences packed with creativity and exploration fun!

title: Escape from the Portal
description:
"Your soul is trapped between worlds. The only way home is to activate an ancient portal... but only one can pass through."
Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld.

title: Push.io
description: Push.io is a fast-paced arena game where you battle to stay on the map and push everyone else off. Wield your boomerang with precision to knock rivals into the water while dodging incoming attacks. The longer you survive, the higher you rank; fall early, and you’ll drop in the standings. Earn trophies, upgrade your boomerang between rounds, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate arena champion.

title: Bubble Sky
description: Bubble Sky is an ascending Bubble Shooter game that will take you to dizzying heights. Will you be able to reach space? Reach a score of 200000 points to unlock the wheel of fortune and win collectible cards to complete your album!

title: Vex X3M 3
description: VEX X3M 3 is here! The most intense Vex hill racing experience yet. Race through new levels filled with traps, sand, electricity, and unpredictable terrain that test your timing and skill. Ride through pipes, master new physics, and take on hard mode or a CPU opponent. Unlock powerful bikes, beat every track, and prove you’re a true VEX X3M rider. Start your engine and take on the challenge!

title: Fireboy & Watergirl 7: and Friends
description:
Fireboy and Watergirl need help to explore this new temple. This time with 3 new friends that will help them solve the puzzles, beat the times and collect all the diamonds! 

Play alone or with a friend to join Fireboy and Watergirl in this new adventure!

Turn levers and push buttons to complete these 36 new levels of the official Fireboy and Watergirl series.

title: Battle Racing Stars
description: Join an epic racing adventure where you can unlock and upgrade iconic characters from beloved Halfbrick games, including Barry from Jetpack Joyride, The Ginger Ninja from Dan the Man, and the nimble ninjas from Fruit Ninja.

title: Savage Defenders
description: A tower defense strategy action game where you become the last hope of a tribe living at the foot of an ancient volcano. When an asteroid with an alien threat falls to the planet, you must combine magic, tactics and the strength of warriors to stop the invader who is devouring all life.

title: Pixel Journey
description: The “Pixel Journey” will appeal to all fans of exploration, collecting resources in a cozy pixel world. It combines a cozy atmosphere and addictive gameplay. Reach the end and find out all the secrets! Support us by leaving a review and comment! If you have any comments or suggestions, please describe them and we will try to make improvements quickly!

title: Battle Arena
description: Fight enemies, grow your army, and dominate the battlefield! Upgrade your camp, train your soldiers and earn tons of coins to expand your unstoppable arsenal. Ready to battle?

title: Twinkle Shooter
description: Shoot at stones of the same color to drop them. They can be cleared when three or more of the same color are matched. If a stone enters the heart, the slot spins for a fever chance! The game is over if the stones reach the bottom.

title: Bublix: Bubble Hit
description: Bublix: Bubble Hit is a fast-paced bubble shooter where precision and strategy matter. Aim, shoot, and match 3 or more bubbles to clear the board. Use clever angles, wall bounces, and combos to boost your score. With endless gameplay and rising difficulty, it’s perfect for quick, addictive sessions.

title: World Soccer
description:
There are four objects, pull the object you want and fire it.
The object moves and pushes the other object or ball away
If you push the ball into the net before the opponent, you win!

title: Max Speed
description: Race shiny sports cars on thrilling 3D tracks full of jumps, stunts, and intense battles. Explore exciting locations with unique challenges, perform daring tricks, upgrade and customize your cars, and test your skills in fast-paced arcade races. Enjoy high-speed action, stunning visuals, and nonstop adrenaline right in your browser.

title: Papas Burger Cook
description:
Cook and travel through amazing burger restaurants, discover delicious recipes, prepare tasty meals, and serve hungry customers in the best burger shop.
This is a crazy cooking game full of fast kitchen action, burger fever, and food madness. Papas Burger Cook - fun cooking simulation game.
Become the ultimate burger chef, master every recipe, and reach the highest rank in this exciting food cooking adventure.

title: Sid & Ginny Y2K Glam Clash
description: Welcome to the Y2K style fashion world! Two charismatic heroines are waiting for you, ready to try on fashion trends from the 2000s. Create spectacular makeup for them with lip gloss, shining shadows and glossy skin; choose stylish hairstyles - from smooth straight hair to playful ponytails and fashionable hairpins. Experiment with low-cut jeans, crop tops, mini skirts, shiny fabrics, and bold combinations. Complete the resulting image with iconic accessories of those years.

title: i8 City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning supercar through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: World Cup 2026 Soccer Game
description:
Choose your national team and enter the excitement of the World Cup! 
Play as your favorite heroes like Cristiano Ronald, Lionel Messi or Kylian Mbappe and jump into fast-paced 1v1 soccer battles to claim the cup! 
Defend your goal, watch for the perfect opening, and strike to score!
Challenge the CPU or compete against friends, sharpen your skills, and climb your way to the top. Victory is just a goal away!

title: Dead Paradise
description: Dead Paradise: Race Shooter is an apocalyptic car game where you drive, shoot enemies, and try to survive until the finish. Completing levels gives you coins to upgrade your car’s missiles, armor, engine, and fuel. You can also buy new vehicles, take missions, and complete daily tasks for extra rewards. Use your resources wisely to make your car stronger and improve your chances of survival.

title: Bimka Drive - Smash cars into splinters!
description: Game created in the style of racing, where you will have no restrictions. But it's not that simple. The fact is that the basis here is based on the physics of actions, because every collision of your car with any obstacle will significantly affect its both external and internal condition. The damage model is made very realistically. Your choice will be a variety of different types of car models that you can test on all kinds of racing tracks. The game is very similar to "BeamNG Drive".

title: Gun Shooting Games Sniper 3D
description: Step into the battlefield and test your precision in Gun Shooting Games: Sniper 3D, an exciting fps experience packed with nonstop action. This immersive first person shooting game puts you in the role of an elite sniper armed with powerful weapons and challenging missions.

title: Obby: Tsunami Escape +1 by Car
description:
A giant tsunami is approaching - and only you can outrun it! Dodge the waves, upgrade your car, and race to the finish line. The faster you get, the further you can go.

Buy new cars - each one gives you more speed, control, and capabilities.
Upgrade your vehicles to survive the most challenging races.
Defeat brainrots - from common to rare and legendary ones.
Practice, improve your reactions, and find the perfect strategy.

title: Romantic K-Pop Transformation
description: In this game, the stars of K-pop are preparing for a romantic transformation. Create a unique images for girls, full of tenderness and brilliance of the stage. Experiment with makeup; change the hairstyles and hair color of the girls. Choose the perfect outfit: from cute dresses and stylish tops to trendy skirts and trousers. Complete the look with fashion accessories. Compare the resulting images and decide which of the heroines of the game has become the real queen of romantic K-pop style.

title: Stick Kill 3D
description: Play as a stickman armed with a pistol in this puzzle-based shooter, where precision and clever thinking are key. Find the right angle, line up your shots, and eliminate enemies in creative ways. Each level becomes more challenging, testing your accuracy and problem-solving skills.

title: Two RX7 Drifters
description: Drift through 3 stunning drift tracks and show how well you can steer the wheels of a powerful rx7. Go head to head with your friend in a drift battle and see whose a better drift racer, customize your ride with stunning body colors, underglows and cool rims. Are you ready to showcase your drifting skills?

title: Number Bubble Shooter Wild West
description: Saddle up for a Wild West number bubble shooter! Shoot and match numbers to merge them into higher values, creating bigger combos and clearing the board. Plan your shots, stack smart, and ride through dusty levels full of challenge and fun!

title: Cute Craft Lab
description: Step into the colorful world of Cute Craft Lab, a super casual game where creativity shines and every girl can become a true crafting designer. If you love relaxing gameplay mixed with adorable creativity, this cute design adventure is made just for you. In Cute Craft Lab, enter a magical workshop filled with charming tools, sparkling decorations, and endless crafting possibilities.

title: Little Dentist Dash
description: Little Dental Dash is a charming clinic management where you step into the role of a friendly dentist helping kids with their dental problems. From fixing chipped teeth to carefully placing braces, each patient brings a new challenge that tests your speed and attention to detail. Treat your young patients, keep them smiling, and earn rewards for your excellent work.

title: Fury Tanks
description: Beyond the hills and forests, war waits in silence. When it starts, it’s you, your tank and the enemy in your sights. Build your armor, power up your cannon and let instinct guide your aim. When the ground shakes, make sure it’s because you fired first.

title: Age of Zombies
description:
Age of Zombies, the nostalgic and thrilling twin-stick shooter, takes you through time to save the world from the undead menace with Barry Steakfries!  Age of Zombies is delivering pure, unadulterated fun with an unforgettable cast of characters.

Experience a lighthearted, action-packed story that spans 24 levels across 8 diverse worlds. Confront 7 unique bosses, encounter a variety of zombie types, and compete in 12 Horde levels for a spot on the leaderboards.

title: Soccer Duel
description: An exciting game in the style of table football, which you can play both alone and with friends on the same device or over the network.

title: Sky Assault
description: Drop from a helicopter into a hostile neon skyscraper! Sky Assault is a tactical vertical shooter where you descend through procedurally generated floors. Eliminate 30 unique enemy types, defeat massive bosses every 10 levels, and loot crates for ammo and weapons. Survival is the only option in this infinite arcade shooter.

title: Archery Master - Bow and Arrow
description:
Join archery adventure and become a bowmaster! Aim, shoot and hit the bullseye!

Pick your bow, defeat other archery masters and don’t let them take you down! Join in this fun and challenging adventure and have fun. Bow masters can really challenge your casual game skills but have no fear! If you enjoy bow and arrow games, then prepare to defeat other bow masters, earn coins, score, and become the ultimate bow master!

title: Arcade GP
description: ARCADE GP is a retro-style top-down Formula 1 racing game with strategic tire management and pit stop mechanics. Race against AI opponents, manage tire wear, and make tactical decisions to claim victory!

title: Ayla World Princess life
description: Step into the magical world of Ayla World: Princess Life, where you can live the ultimate princess adventure! This exciting game lets you dress up your avatar, create stunning outfits, and design beautiful nails with endless styles.

title: Cars with Guns: Wasteland Showdown
description:
Accept the challenge of the post-apocalyptic wasteland. Take on contracts, earn money and reputation, and collect valuable loot.
Survival belongs to those with the fastest ride and the biggest gun.

title: Dream Kitchen
description: Dream Kitchen is a fun and fast-paced restaurant simulation game inspired by shawarma-style cooking gameplay. Take customer orders, cook the right food, and serve every dish on time to keep customers happy. Complete levels with 3-star ratings, earn coins, upgrade your kitchen equipment, and unlock new recipes. Explore multiple themed chapters, including a Pancake Shop, Street Stall, Fast Food Restaurant, and Western Restaurant, each with unique dishes and challenges!

title: GT Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 awesome cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills?

title: Pool Duel
description: Keep your focus sharp as the clock ticks down, knowing that timing and precision will lead you to victory. Master your aim and cue control, because flawless execution and smart strategy separate true champions from the rest in every challenging match.

title: Flick Shot Soccer
description: Flick Shot Soccer is a fun and addictive soccer shooting game where every goal is all about precision. Simply drag to aim and position your shot, then release to kick and send the ball flying into the net. Easy controls make it perfect for anyone to pick up and play, while smart angles and timing are needed to score consistently.

title: Tsunami Brainrots Online
description: Tsunami Brainrots Online is a fast-paced survival experience inspired by meme culture and chaotic movement gameplay. Players must escape a massive tsunami wave while exploring dangerous areas, collecting valuable brainrot characters, and returning safely before time runs out. The game offers an online single-player mode where you can interact with others through chat, as well as a local 2 player option for shared-screen action.

title: 2048 Mayhem.io
description: Welcome to 2048 Mayhem.io! Combine the classic 2048 puzzle mechanics with thrilling .io snake survival gameplay. Collect cubes to grow your tail, merge identical numbers, and hunt down smaller players to become the biggest 2048 cube in the arena. Use your dash ability to escape danger or catch your prey. Can you reach 2048 and dominate the leaderboard?

title: My Cake Shop: Bake & Serve
description: Run your own sweet bakery in My Cake Shop! Bake and stack colorful donuts, clean messy floors, and serve hungry customers. Expand across the world by unlocking new bakery locations and upgrading machines. Manage crowds, grow your patisserie empire, and become the ultimate idle arcade tycoon!

title: Cool SuperCars Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: 2 Player Games Kids Kitchen
description: Do you want to run your own restaurant? Want to experience the blend of collaboration and cooking fun? Join H5games4u's best restaurant tycoon game and enjoy cooking fun. You will engage in different gaming modes. The best part is that you can work together with your friends in the virtual restaurant!

title: M5 City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning muscle through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: TapKO
description: One-tap fighter game. From the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride, get ready to rumble with TapKO - the knockout idle game that packs a punch! Jab, bob, and weave your way to the top, and train your fighter to become the ultimate boxer.

title: Slippery Drift Racing
description: Slippery Drift Racing is an adrenaline-pumping racing game where precision and speed go hand in hand. Players can choose between Race and Time Attack modes, tackling five unique and challenging maps. With three difficulty levels—Easy, Normal, and Hard—drivers of all skill levels can enjoy sliding through tight corners, mastering drifts, and racing against the clock or opponents. Perfect for fans of high-speed thrills and skillful maneuvers, every race promises excitement and challenge!

title: Brainrot World Hole.io
description: Brainrot World Hole.io is a hilarious casual hole game packed with chaotic brainrot energy and funny Italian meme vibes. Control a growing hole and dive into a crazy world where swallowing everything in sight is the key to victory. Move around the map and collect objects smaller than your hole.

title: Stardom Alt-Girls Fashion Duel
description: Welcome to the world of daring alternative glamour! Meet two star heroines - Sydney and Sabrina. Help them go beyond the usual and try on the most daring alternative images: from a gentle soft-grunge princess to a gloomy rock diva. In the game, you can make bright makeup with arrows and sparkles; create unusual hairstyles; collect memorable outfits from tops, corsets, mini skirts and oversized jackets. Create your own collection of stunning Alt-girl looks!

title: Snow Rider Obby Parkour
description:
Snow Rider Obby Parkour is a fast-paced snowboard adventure where reflexes, timing, and control matter. Play solo or with a friend in split-screen mode and experience different snow challenges across multiple game modes. Whether you want to beat distance records, explore a massive open world, or race down dangerous mountains, this game offers a complete snowboarding experience.

Master your snowboard, perform double jumps, and unlock amazing gear to customize your character!

title: Police Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 awesome police cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Luxury Highway Cars!

title: Taylor Dress Studio Preppy & Wild West & Glam
description: Welcome to the dress-up game, in which the pop diva tries on three completely different fashionable looks: a youthful preppy bow, a cowboy outfit and a glamorous stage look. In addition, you can experiment with hairstyles and change the makeup of the heroine. Complete the images with accessories: glasses, hats and jewelry. Choose clothes and combine elements from different sets to create delicate, daring or superstar bows. Turn Taylor into an icon of any style!

title: Besties Chinese New Year Celebration
description: Besties Chinese New Year Celebration invites you into a joyful world of color, tradition, and friendship as you help best friends prepare for the Lunar New Year. Dress them up in beautiful traditional outfits, elegant modern looks, and festive accessories inspired by Chinese New Year celebrations.

title: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style
description: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style brings romance, fashion, and K-pop glamour together in one stylish dress-up experience. Help your favorite K-pop hunters transform their looks for Valentine’s Day with stunning outfits, flawless makeup, and charming accessories.

title: Hot & Cold Winter Style
description: Princesses Eliza and Milana are going on winter vacation, but for each of the girls, winter vacation will be special. Eliza lives in snowy regions and loves fluffy fur coats, warm scarves and winter dresses. Milana celebrates her holidays under palm trees and chooses swimsuits, light capes and bright accessories. Players will have to create stylish images, combining the cold shine of snow and the warm glow of the tropics. Help Eliza and Milana become the most fashionable princesses of winter!

title: Fashion Stylist Salon Makeover
description: Do you want to create your own fashion styles? Join our best hair salon simulator game and enjoy the utmost fun. You will act as a fashion stylist who does haircuts, hairstyling, and skin care. Welcome customers with different requirements and use your hairstyling skills to make them satisfied and happy!

title: Super Football Fever
description: We bring you an unprecedentedly realistic soccer experience with smooth motion-captured animations and lifelike 3D graphics that make you feel like you're on a top-tier league field. Build your dream team, sign superstars, and win matches with precise tactical arrangements. Whether it's quick short passes or stunning long-range goals, you can do it all with ease at your fingertips.

title: Pickle Ball Clash
description: Step into the fast-paced world of Pickle Ball Clash — a thrilling sports game where every match is a battle of skill, speed, and strategy. Customize your character, unlock powerful paddles, and climb the competitive ranks from backyard brawls to pro-level leagues. Whether you're smashing winners or pulling off trick shots, the court is yours to conquer. Are you ready to clash?

title: Cozy Kitchen Merge
description: This is an addictive cooking-themed merge game you won't be able to put down. Here, you'll become a kitchen master by merging identical ingredients and dishes to create new, more delicious cuisine. From simple vegetables to exotic feasts, continuously unlock tasty recipes from around the world. Fulfill customer orders to earn coins, and use them to upgrade and decorate your kitchen, transforming it from a humble diner into a dream culinary paradise.

title: Dance On Hotsteps Mobile
description: Welcome to Dance On - Hotsteps Mobile, a modern dance game that you can play for free on H5games4u. Dress up your superstar in beautiful suits and dresses, follow the beats of the music, make perfect dance moves, and surprise the crowd in the dancing show!

title: Basket Swap
description: Slide into the gray blocks to help you position the ball and grid correctly. If you're stuck, click on the arrow in the bottom left corner to undo your last move, or press R to restart the level.

title: Champions FC
description: Champions FC is a fast-paced, bite-size soccer match where you dribble, pass, and time your kicks to break through defenders and score. Play two quick halves, react to turnovers, and keep the ball in bounds. Nail the perfect moment, hear the whistle, and become Champion.

title: K-Wedding Dream
description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of Korean love with the heroes of this dressup-game. Become a part of a magical story where bright K-Pop stars are preparing for the most important day of their lives - Wedding day! Combine tradition and modern fashion by creating wedding looks for lovers. Choose the perfect makeup, hairstyle and jewelry to highlight their unique style and charm. Let each of your choices reflect the emotions and dreams of the characters, turning this day into a real fairy tale!

title: MergeDuel.io
description: Merge Duel is a fast-paced 1v1 battle game where strategy and quick decisions lead to victory. Merge and upgrade your cannons to summon powerful units and counter your opponent in real time. Every match challenges your tactical skills as you adapt to new enemies and situations. Climb the ranks, dominate the leaderboard, and enjoy vibrant visuals, smooth controls, and intense duels from start to finish.

title: Celebrities Get Ready For Christmas
description: Step into the world of ‘Celebrities Get Ready for Christmas’! Join your favorite stars as they prepare for the festive season. Explore dazzling holiday outfits, glamorous decorations, and witness the magic of Christmas through the eyes of celebrities. Get ready for a star-studded holiday celebration! Play and have fun!

title: Pool Master
description: From a rookie with a cue to a legend of the table, journey through 100 challenging levels with closed pockets, special balls to clear and more. Unlock custom gear, gain special boosts and rule the table with precision and power.

title: Radical Rappelling
description:
Feel the rush and hold on tight as Radical Rappelling is back!

Join Rip and Roxy as you rappel down mountains at breakneck speed using your rapid reflexes.

Pull off death-defying tricks by ricocheting between launch pads, riding rainbows and rocketing over obstacles in the most redonkulous adventure ever.

Rack up coins and complete rockin’ missions to unlock sweet new gear for Rip and Roxy, the most fearless risk-takers on the planet.

title: Ping Pong Air
description: Table tennis, also known as ping pong, is an easy and enjoyable arcade game in which you control the bat as simply as in life: with the mouse or the movement of your finger. Several modes await you to suit every taste. In classic mode, you go through worlds, earn cups and unlock new opportunities. In Halloween mode, you have to banish spirits for a while, improving your reaction. In Career mode, you move up the tournament ladder, taking part in games against increasingly stronger opponents.

title: Basketball Stars 2026
description: Basketball Stars is a cool 2 player basketball game by MadPuffers. Prepared for the 2025 basketball season. Choose your team and enter a challenging tournament. Control your player to perform awesome dunks and 3-pointers to win the game. Feel free to block and slap your opponent to knock him out and get the ball, and pay attention to the supershot bar on the top of the screen. Once fully loaded, you can use the hot special dunk from wherever you stand; it never fails. Be the best player!

title: Football Duel
description: Step into the arena in Football Duel! Take turns shooting and goalkeeping in this thrilling 3D penalty showdown. Swipe to score or defend — the first to 5 goals claims victory!

title: Snow Ball Racing Mutliplayer
description:
Roll. Race. Win!

Build the biggest snowball you can — then launch it down the slope and watch it fly! The farther it rolls, the more wins you earn. Use wins to unlock new zones, collect pets, and climb the leaderboard.

Fast, satisfying, and endlessly replayable. Snowball Racing is perfect for players who love speed, upgrades, and competition.

title: Basketball Fever
description:
Get ready for endless basketball fun! Basketball Fever features four exciting basketball challenges anyone can enjoy. 

Sharpen your aim, beat your high score, or just enjoy quick bursts of arcade-style fun, Basketball Fever delivers nonstop action that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. It’s the ultimate way to test your reflexes, timing, and accuracy.

Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying physics make every shot feel rewarding.

title: MMA Super Fight
description: The crowd is roaring, the spotlight is on you. From rookie to legend — face endless fights, unlock unique fighters and upgrade power, defense, health and regeneration. With every match, the pressure rises. The ring never sleeps and neither can you.

title: Obby Tower
description:
Climb. Think. Survive.

Ascend a towering obstacle course filled with tricky jumps, moving platforms — and surprise math challenges! Combine your parkour skills with quick thinking to make it to the top.

Perfect for players who love obbies and want to test both reflexes and brainpower.

title: Knife.io
description: Knife.io is a fast-paced 2D battle game where you throw knives at your enemies to eliminate them! Dodge incoming attacks, aim precisely, and take down as many opponents as possible without getting hit. With vibrant worlds to explore and tons of unique characters to unlock, every match is a colorful and action-packed challenge. Play solo or team up with a friend in local multiplayer, only the sharpest player will survive!

title: UGC Math Race
description:
Run fast. Think faster!

Solve math problems on the go in this competitive racing game! Choose the correct answer to stay on track, one mistake and you fall. 

Perfect for players who love speed, smarts, and math.

title: Brainrot Hole
description: Brainrot Hole is a fun casual game where you control a hole that sucks in objects. Your task is to guide the hole to eat all the objects and defeat all the Brainrot Enemies . As you progress through the levels,  the game gets more challenging with more complex obstacles to avoid. Use your strategy and quick reflexes to become the ultimate Brainrot Hole master!

title: Words or Die
description:
Build words to survive — think fast or get crushed!

In this fast-paced word survival game, players race to create words from random letters. Each correct word builds a tower under your feet. Fail to spell on time? Lava rises, and you're out!

 - Stay above the lava
 - Show off your vocabulary skills
 - Compete against others in real-time
 - Choose your character and style
 - Only the smartest will survive!

title: Guivo.io
description:
Challenge the world in Guivo.io, a skill-based Match-3 battle arena playable instantly in your browser! Match pieces, shatter ice and outscore opponents in lightning-fast 2-minute rounds.
Climb our chess-inspired Elo ranking system based solely on skill, earn Trophies with each victory and see your name showcased in the winner's banner. Ready to prove you're the puzzle master?

title: Natural disaster survival Obby
description:
Immerse yourself in an exciting Roblox-style adventure with the game “Natural disaster survival Obby”! 

Dynamic maps are waiting for you, where disasters are happening every second - lava flows, floods, tornadoes and much more. Pass the obby trials, dodge the dangers and try to survive the longest! 

Play online with friends and other players from all over the world. 
Unlock stylish skins and unique pets to stand out from the rest.

title: Press "A" to Party
description: Press A to Party is a casual arcade game collection designed for players of all ages. Gather your friends and family, settle onto the couch, and dive into the action with simple one-button controls and fast-paced gameplay. Compete against up to 4 players on the same screen, vying for the coveted title of the ultimate arcade champion. Get ready for a blast of fun and excitement at your next gathering!

title: Obby: Gym Simulator, Escape
description:
Help Obby build up his muscles to escape from the castle!
Swing and get bigger!

The game has a rank system.
Defeat bosses, compete with other players for the first place in the ranking!

Spend cups on eggs, collect all the pets.
They will help you swing much faster.

It's up to you to press a barbell, carry weights or lift dumbbells.

title: Squid Game: Craft Runner
description:
Join the fun in Squid Game Subway Craft! Craft your way through obstacles and race along the railway tracks in a Minecraft-style world. Face exciting challenges, meet cool characters, and show your skills as you survive the ultimate test in this action-packed game inspired by Squid Game!"

title: SquidGame.io
description: Engage in free multiplayer survival! Compete in 7-minute minigames against 30 rivals. Based on the hit Netflix show, test your skills and strategy. Fail a challenge, get eliminated by Pink Soldiers! Adapt and outmaneuver to survive. Will you be the last one standing?
